observer.scope: Mean per-sample collector process CPU cost divided by configured cadence, not an observer-off comparison. Per-collection cost excludes JSON serialization/flush and idle; the complete observer's total CPU includes other phases. Ratio to load CPU uses independently sampled local aggregate telemetry intervals and is approximate.

threads.scope: CPU joins require identical process identity and TID/startTicks; new/disappeared threads contribute no guessed CPU. Thread-name groups can combine many instances and kernel-truncated names. schedstat/wchan only cover the collector's selected top16 threads; wchan=0 can mean running or unavailable, and zero schedstat can mean disabled instrumentation. This does not identify a unique causal bottleneck.

udpSockets.scope: Only verified owned PID sockets with fd/inode ownership rechecked by the collector. Adjacent joins require identical process/family/inode/localbind and an overlapping fd set. Newly observed counters are not counted as arrival-window drops. Disappearance is observed absence, not a certified close; gaps, races and fd caps can hide sockets. Queue gauges are kernel-accounting bytes, not packets or effective SO_RCVBUF capacity. Drops are observed socket drop-counter increments, not business-command losses or proof of the unique loss mechanism; resets/wraps are excluded.

recorderCounters.samplingScope: CapacityCounters records timestamp after the counter scan; samplingNanos spans the scan and timestamp construction. Conservatively require timestamp-samplingNanos >= arrival start and timestamp <= arrival end. The frozen helper then differences first/last identical counter registrations over elapsedNanos, which is local monotonic time at scan start. This cumulative-counter coverage may span missed interior observations, unlike adjacent-pair thread/socket CPU coverage. Counter values and position differences are non-atomic; no exact lag or physical disk service-time inference. Archive type107 is cumulative wall time in the write path including write+force+descheduling; it is not pure fsync latency.
recorderCounters.scope: Only unchanged counter id + registration id + type + label identities are differenced; missing/reused registrations are not assumed zero. Positions identified by label/type and log stream 100. Follower receive-HWM is distinct from leader append position. Position differences are signed non-atomic observations, not exact lag or fsync durability proof.

scope: Requested complete registered finite observations only. Node-only idle changes maximum park for selected node data-path roles; fixed e57 multiplexed load is a separate artifact. The alternative18k mode retains its original direct/multiplexed factor and same e57 artifact, never merged with idle. Strict pilot and formal are separate. Process/TID/startTicks/inode/FD-overlap/whole-collection interior and monotonic gap rules are frozen; missing is not zero. CnC first/last cumulative deltas have different coverage from adjacent CPU/socket pairs. Positions are non-atomic differences, not exact lag; archive write-path wall time includes force/descheduling. Invalid/failed attempts remain diagnostic and cannot establish capacity. Finite paths do not prove sustained capacity, universal ceilings, unique causation or a full replicated checkpoint/restart.
